fix_results.fix_summary: Removed the 'Main Menu' text label from the home button in ResultsView, keeping only the house.fill icon as requested by the user. The text label was causing translation issues and taking up unnecessary space. The fix maintains WCAG accessibility compliance by adding an explicit accessibilityLabel that still provides the 'Main Menu' text for VoiceOver users. The icon size was increased from .body to .title2 to make it more prominent as a standalone icon button.
